messages:
anya (DevEx): quick flag from support: customer rotated their project key and the Go sample app picked up the new key but the Node sample kept using the old org key. short repro below.
ben (SDK-js): yikes. which env vars and sdk versions?
anya (DevEx): env: 
```
REDWOOD_PROJECT=beta-team
REDWOOD_PROJECT_KEY=proj_v2
REDWOOD_API_KEY=org_old
```
Go app (sdk-go v0.9.0) started working after we injected proj_v2. Node app (sdk-js v0.11.1) continued outbound requests with org_old and got 403/401.
rui (SDK-go): I dug into both SDKs. sdk-go checks [REDWOOD_PROJECT -> REDWOOD_PROJECT_KEY -> REDWOOD_API_KEY], but sdk-js still had a legacy alias check for REDWOOD_PROJECTTOKEN and an early-return that picks the first non-empty env. we recently added REDWOOD_PROJECT_KEY in docs, but sdk-js kept the old var for backward compatibility and the precedence landed wrong.
ben (SDK-js): confirmed. legacy code path reads REDWOOD_PROJECTTOKEN then REDWOOD_API_KEY and never sees REDWOOD_PROJECT_KEY in older builds. that explains the mismatch in behavior during rotation.
harper (Prod): we need two things: 1) quick patch to sdk-js to check both the new and legacy project env names and prefer project-scoped keys when REDWOOD_PROJECT is set, and 2) a one-time deprecation warning for the legacy var so users migrate cleanly. also add doc note: never bake REDWOOD_API_KEY in images during rotation.
rui (SDK-go): also recommend adding a small diagnostic in the sample apps: log which env var was used for auth on startup (masked) so operators can see whether project or org key is active. keeps support noise down.
ben (SDK-js): will send a patch to alias REDWOOD_PROJECTTOKEN -> REDWOOD_PROJECT_KEY and change precedence: if REDWOOD_PROJECT present, prefer project key (new or legacy) over org key. add console.warn and a `redwood doctor --auth` lint. PR: https://git.internal/pulls/2222 (adds tests for env matrix).
infra-bot: deploy: sdk-js@0.11.2 -> staging (commit d4e5f6)
ben (SDK-js): tests passed in CI, merged and published sdk-js@0.11.2. changelog: "Honor REDWOOD_PROJECT when resolving credentials; support legacy REDWOOD_PROJECTTOKEN alias; warn on legacy var; avoid retrying on auth mismatch."
anya (DevEx): validated sample apps in staging. both SDKs now pick up proj_v2 and rotation works without falling back to org_old. adding quickstart note about aliasing and rotation checklist. closing loop with support. thanks folks :raised_hands:
